hourly.summary: United fans are wallowing in dark deadline-day despair: no striker, no left back, Zirkzee off to Everton on loan, and a late Aït-Nouri enquiry laughed off by City. The mood is grimly resigned—"same old United" under the Glazers/INEOS—with plenty of self-deprecating gallows humour and "here for the meltdowns" energy.

daily.summary: Sentiment improved sharply over the day, moving from cautious relief after a comeback win to full-blown optimism as academy standouts and Bruno Fernandes' heroics dominated discussions. The early concerns about transfers and defensive issues faded into the background, replaced by belief in the club's young talent and momentum. Overall, the vibe trend is upward, ending the day on a clearly positive note.

weekly.summary: The week began in anxiety and anguish following an opening-day loss to Hull and transfer frustrations, briefly lifted by cautious optimism before a second Hull defeat (Carabao Cup) plunged sentiment to disastrous lows. A stunning 5-2 comeback victory over Ipswich with a Bruno Fernandes hat-trick then triggered a euphoric swing, capping a wildly volatile week.
